title: Termination of Adult Establishments
previewText: In all districts, a non-conforming adult establishment shall terminate within one year from October 25, 1995, or from such later date that the adult establishment becomes non-conforming, except that such establishment may be continued for a limited period of time by the Board of Standards and Appeals pursuant to Section 72-40 (AMORTIZATION OF CERTAIN ADULT ESTABLISHMENTS AND SIGNS FOR ADULT ESTABLISHMENTS). amendmentHistory.description: AMENDMENT TO DISCONTINUE MORATORIUM ON NEW ADULT ESTABLISHMENTS AND PROVIDE PERMANENT REGULATIONS ON THE SITING OF ADULT ESTABLISHMENTS TO PROTECT AGAINST THEIR ADVERSE EFFECTS WHILE ALLOWING SUFFICIENT ACCESS TO ADULT MATERIALS.
